official_sources.locator: Stock Extension Outside Diameter (OD) Tolerances*; web extracted lines267..294
official_sources.facts: General extension section publishes rate +/-10%. DIN2097/MIL-SPEC footnote is tied to starred OD heading. Do not claim the footnote unambiguously exempts spring rate; do not transfer rate tolerance to F0.
03096-14 transfers pulling force; shortening permitted; free end depends on routing/load and needs readjustment; R>=65 including installation; sheath compression-only.
